subject: Continuous20 CPU phase coincides with high host commit/paging pressure
body: Additional read-only evidence for the continuous20 sanity review: PID33516 is single-thread CPU-active with no disk I/O delta and no observed GPU kernels during repeated samples; private memory ~10.86 GB, working set shrinking. Host has ~31.73 GiB physical / ~3.12 GiB free and ~68.2 GB committed against ~74.3 GB commit limit, with transient hundreds of pages/sec and page reads/sec. This makes memory-pressure/working-set churn a plausible explanation for the prolonged CPU/GPU-idle phase. No intervention performed. Worker remains responsive; no adapter or completion receipt yet.
